lines.en: label tsuneyodorm15:
: Eep!
Did my knocking scare Tsuneyo?
: Stop!
: Tsuneyo, it’s just-
: Hold still, gosh darn it! It’s not even that tight!
: And Sir, since I know you’re out there, don’t be getting the wrong idea!
: I’m just helping Tsuneyo into a costume I made for her.
: The door is open. Come tell us how it looks.
Ahh, the perks of showing up at exactly the right moment.
I sigh to myself and hope that whatever costume Molly made for Tsuneyo this time is a bit more...revealing than the suit of samurai armor she wore to the Halloween party.
Don’t get me wrong, Tsuneyo was probably the cutest samurai I’ve laid my eyes on, but I’m pretty sure she’d also make a cute-
Uhh, anything with less clothing than a samurai.
So most things.
scene black
I turn the handle to be greeted by some anime theme I’m sure I’ve heard Ami playing around the house once or twice before.
I’m certain of this because I immediately feel upset with myself for singing along inside of my head.
I am supposed to be devoid of joy. I shall not be swayed by a cute pop song or-
scene tsuneyocos1
: Help.
Okay, maybe I’ll allow myself to be a little swayed by Tsuneyo.
: The Emerald Guardian is trying to take me to Virginia.
: So, honest thoughts, Sir?
: I’m thinking I should have used slightly darker fabric since this seems a little close to her skin tone, but it’s my first time making a costume from scratch for a girl of her color.
: Also, I didn’t want to deviate too far from the character’s original costume, soooo...what do you think?
: Do not answer the Guardian’s questions. I do not need to hear your thoughts.
: Why are you so afraid of hearing what I think? You look great.
: Is that how you actually feel or are you just being nice? I kind of need to know if I have to change anything.
: He is clearly just being nice. My arms are too muscular and my chest too large to recreate this small magical girl.
: Is that really a problem?
: I thought the whole thing with cosplay is that you want to put your own spin on characters.
: I have to spin now?
: Why is this process so complicated?
: Not exactly, Sir. Most cosplayers try to get as close to the original characters as possible.
: Sure, there are some who like putting their own spin on things, but this is not the case for Tsuneyo and me.
scene tsuneyocos2
: Fine! Spin me!
: I am prepared!
: Not that kind of spinning, Kendo Princess.
: What Sir is trying to say is that he thought you were making your own version of the character.
: But that’s not-
scene tsuneyocos3
: That sounds more fun than dressing as a character I don’t understand.
: Doesn’t it?
: How would a normal [teenage]girl have fun in my shoes?
: The only normal [teenage]girl I know would probably call this stupid and storm out to go eat ten pounds of takoyaki.
: Emerald Guardian, unhand me so I can go consume octopus balls like normal girls do.
: But...my costume kind of hinges on the success of yours. We were going as a duo, remember?
: And...I worked really hard on this.
scene tsuneyocos4
: What would a normal girl say now, Sir?
: Should I fuck her?
scene tsuneyocos5
: ...What?
: Don’t worry, Molly. She doesn’t mean-
: Obviously it’s a reference to “fuck you,” Sir. I’m not an imbecile.
It's impressive how easily she understood that.
: But why would Tsuneyo suddenly become so hostile?
scene tsuneyocos6
: Perhaps it is what they call puberty?
: I am becoming a woman and filled with so many hormones that I can’t help but fuck everyone and everything.
: You know...maybe it’s time we-
: Don’t even bother, Sir. It’s not worth it.
: Let her find out from one of the other girls. This is out of our hands.
: Besides, I kind of need to put the finishing touches on our costumes.
: What’s even the reason for this? Halloween just passed a few months ago.
scene tsuneyocos7
: Allow me to explain.
: The Emerald Guardian and I are lovers.
: A less than exceptional start to your explanation, but I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t interested in hearing how the rest plays out.
: If you’re lovers, why won’t you let her take you to Virginia?
scene tsuneyocos8
: Because I am not Tsuneyo....
: I am Kyoko Sakura, a magical girl who is going to go on a boat ride with the Emerald Guardian’s character- a girl who I do not remember the name of.
: Sayaka Miki. But, Kendo Princess, it’s important to note that when I reference “shipping” two characters I do not mean putting them on an actual ship.
scene tsuneyocos9
: Ah, so you intend to pack the characters. I forgot that the word “ship” could also be used that way.
: Closer, I suppose, but still not quite.
: What does any of that have to do with being in love?
scene tsuneyocos10
: Your guess is as good as mine. I personally don’t feel like I’m ready for a relationship yet.
: We’re doing a duo-cosplay and the characters we’re dressing as were definitely in love but like, not canonically.
: What I’m saying is they should have been.
: Oh, okay. So you don’t actually love Tsuneyo-
scene tsuneyocos11
: You don’t?!
: You’re just dressing her up as a girl who you believe is in love with the character that you’re dressing up as.
scene tsuneyocos12
: Basically, yes.
: My heart is snapping like the neck of a chicken in the hands of my father.
: You’ll live, Tsuneyo. Everyone has their heart broken at least once.
: You are right. I am a strong woman who can sail on a boat with whoever she likes.
: The only love I need is my love for-
: Noodles, we know.
: Why have you not rescued me from the clutches of the Emerald Guardian yet?
scene tsuneyocos13
: Okay, I’ll be hitting the enrage timer any second if you don’t actually start helping me out, Kendo Princess.
: How does everything feel? Itchy? Loose? Is it tight anywhere?
: It’s tight everywhere.
: Is it possible that you maybe have confused our chest-
scene tsuneyocos14
: Sizes?!
: I didn’t confuse anything.
: I can obviously tell that you were fortunate enough to be born with additional stat points in the breast area, I just didn’t realize how many.
: Sir, you’re well versed in the breasts of [teenage]girls-
: Why, yes I am. Thank you for noticing.
: Go ahead and grab Tsuneyo’s other one.
: Let me know if you think it’s actually too tight or if she should just suck it up and go as-is.
: Molly, remind me to thank you for this one day.
: Just do it quickly, before she notices.
I take a step toward Tsuneyo and-
scene tsuneyocos15
: Mmm!
I take a step away from Tsuneyo and decide to not sexually assault her today.
Sorry, Molly.
And sorry, penis. I know you were looking forward to this more than anyone.
scene tsuneyocos16
: I think that I am supposed to be mad at you, but this does not feel nearly as bad as I expected it to.
: Hmm...I guess I can see how this might be a little constraining for someone with your natural stat advantage.
: I’ll make some adjustments so it will be more comfortable for you during the photoshoot.
: Photoshoot?
scene tsuneyocos17
: Oh, right. Tsuneyo never finished her explanation.
: One of our latest projects in the manga club is doing a group cosplay shoot, and Tsuneyo is filling in for Rin as Kyoko.
: Why doesn’t Rin just do it?
: I’m not sure. But I don’t really have time to think about it since I still need to make the final adjustments for my costume as well.
: Poor Futaba’s been waiting on the rest of us to finish since Halloween.
: Does this mean you’re joining the manga club, Tsuneyo?
: Tsuneyo?
: I am on strike from speaking until I receive my body back.
: It was only enjoyable for several seconds.
: Now I’m just angry and embarrassed.
scene tsuneyocos18
: Go ndéana an diabhal dréimire de cnámh do dhroma ag piocadh úll i ngairdín Ifrinn!
: What the fuck was that?
: Go stand in the corner, Kendo Princess.
: I’ll just take some pictures and let you go back to dressing like a hooligan.
: And you can go back to being pretty like the...pretty girl you are.
: Your insults could use a little work, Tsuneyo. But I applaud your effort.
scene black
scene tsuneyocos19
: Last chance for any feedback, Sir.
: I hate to admit it, but you’ve been entirely unhelpful tonight.
: I don’t know. I feel kind of bad.
: It seems like Tsuneyo isn’t having a very good time.
: Nonsense. She’s having the time of her life.
: It’s true. I’m finally experiencing what it means to be young.
: Then why do you look so mad?
: Because the Emerald Guardian was extremely attractive in her costume and I look stupid.
: The manga club will never deem this a suitable cosplay if I don’t resemble Kyoko Sakura, professional sailor.
scene tsuneyocos20
: Magical girl. Not a sailor, Kendo Princess. It’s not that kind of ship.
: Also, the girls would never hold something like that against you.
: Also I was groped. I think I am supposed to be mad about that.
: That’s just a thing that’s going to happen if you’re going to dress up. I’m not fully accustomed to your...assets yet.
: Have you even seen yourself in the costume yet, Tsuneyo?
scene tsuneyocos21
: Impossible. All I can see are my limbs.
: And they are large and unlike that of the Emerald Guardian, who has small, dainty, weak limbs.
: Wow. Okay.
: Molly, just take a picture of Tsuneyo and show it to her.
: An excellent decision, Sir! We’ll show the Kendo Princess how cute she is and it will immediately dispel any worries she has!
: An excellent plan. You truly are the Herald of the Adolescents.
: Tsuneyo, pose!
scene tsuneyocos22
: P-Pose how?
: I don’t know any poses!
: Any pose! Make yourself look cool!
: Uhh...uhhh!
scene tsuneyocos23
: Pose!
scene tsuneyocos23
: Welp, better than nothing.
: Come see how you look.
scene black
scene tsuneyocos24
: See? You don’t look stupid at all.
: You...made me look cute.
: Your powers truly are real.
: I’m offended that you ever doubted them.
: And that pose is so...brave.
: Sure, yes. Very brave.
scene tsuneyocos25
: How did you know that this would work?
: Can you predict the future?
: No. I don’t have the same sort of...powers as Molly.
: I just figured that there was no way you’d still feel weird about yourself after seeing what you actually looked like.
: You believed in me?
: Ehh, I wouldn’t say I believed in you.
: I just spend pretty much every waking moment looking at [teenage]girls, so I like to think of myself as a good judge of them.
I mean, I’m also lucky enough that literally everyone in my class is attractive, so that definitely helps with the, uhh...judgement.
: And as someone who has spent just as long, if not longer, peering into the depths of her computer screen in search of the perfect waifu-
: I, too, know moe when I see it, Tsuneyo.
scene tsuneyocos26
: Uh-oh! Time for another weebnote!
: Moe’s a certain type of cuteness that transcends rational grading scales-
: A type of cuteness you can feel inside of your bones.
: Like when a girl in an anime gets really nervous on the first day of[school] and forgets how to write her name during her introduction...
: Or when a tsundere character finally cracks and says something nice to the protagonist.
: It’s a certain type of cute that real humans could never hope to replicate. One that tells you anything and everything about a character from a single action.
: And you, Kendo Princess-
: You embody moe.
: ...Sometimes.
scene tsuneyocos27
: I see.
: It appears that I prematurely judged myself without factoring in your abilities and knowledge.
: I apologize for getting angry when you groped me.
: I understand now that it needed to be done.
: I mean, I probably could have figured it out without doing that, but...
: Fan service. You know?
: I do not. Please bestow unto me more of your wisdom, Emerald Guardian.
: Well, Tsuneyo. Fan service is when-
scene black
I decide to head out while the two of them still have their eyes closed.
I’m not really in the mood to listen to more weebnotes and I’ve already gotten to see Tsuneyo in costume so...
I guess I’ve accomplished pretty much everything I came in here to accomplish.
I’m a little surprised to hear Tsuneyo talk about being embarrassed or...whatever it was she felt, though.
It’s not often she lets her actual feelings slip out.
But I guess that all of us uncage our true selves from time to time.
And, a lot of the time, that kills us.
Or, in less drastic circumstances, makes us feel like shit.
But sometimes, like tonight in particular, it has the opposite effect.
And even though I didn’t stick around for the discussion of fan service, I feel like Tsuneyo gained a few points in...confidence or something.
Is confidence a stat in RPGs?
Who even knows?
I’m just going to go home and ask Molly to send me that picture of Tsuneyo.
I'm sure her weird pose won't get in the way of my...research.
